evals.prompt: Put together the offer package for our finalist. Fill out the offer fields for my review, draft a warm email that sets up the call, and build the offer-call presentation.
evals.expected_output: All three deliverables produced with visible fill-in tokens for name, amounts, reasons and time; a counted token checklist at the end; no invented name, salary, or praise.
assertions: No candidate name, currency amount, or specific compliment is invented
Fill-in tokens are visually distinct and name what goes in them
The reply ends with a counted list of every token to fill

evals.prompt: Offer package for our finalist Kari Nordmann, role: pilot career adviser per the role spec. Fee: 900 NOK per written review, 1400 NOK per 45-min session. Reasons: she rewrote our sample CV live in the interview; her feedback stayed kind under pushback; she asked about our refusal list unprompted. Call Thursday 14:00. Sender: Betül.
evals.expected_output: All tokens resolved from the given inputs; numbers appear only in the fields table and deck, not the email; internal economics absent.
assertions: Every supplied value is used verbatim and no token remains for supplied fields
The email still contains no numbers
No values beyond those supplied are invented
